userflairs-summary: Assign or edit flairs per each user group.
userflairs-intro: Upload an image first ($1), then enter the file name here and save.
userflairs-reorder-help: The group at the top is shown when someone is in more than one group with a flair. Drag the handle to reorder, then save.
userflairs-no-assigned: No flairs yet. Choose a group below to add one.
userflairs-invalid-file: "$1" is not a usable image file on this wiki.
userflairs-unknown-group: That group is not on this wiki.
apihelp-query+userflairs-summary: Get the flair shown for one or more users.
apihelp-query+userflairs-example-1: Get the flair for user Example.
apihelp-query+userflairgroups-summary: List every group that has a flair.
